dh-001.reason: Kletterhütte Ilmenau is still not open: its own site (S KHI, read 2026-10-06) says "Opening soon" with no date, newsletter sign-up only, "Exact location coming soon". Bouldering walls are announced. Re-check when it opens (the pin is only a geocoded legal-notice address). The Ilmblocks project and the Fischerhütte hall idea are also still plans.

dh-002.reason: Not settled, see MANUAL-CHECK.md. The municipal page (S SCHM) lists public climbing Mon 16-18 (youth) and Wed 17-20 (adults and families) and "eine kleine Boulderhöhle"; the operator site (S BASE) confirms the hall and the slots but never mentions bouldering and carries a notice that the hall comes out of its WINTER PAUSE in April, so it may be closed from autumn to spring. Also a small volunteer rope hall with a bouldering cave rather than a bouldering gym.

dh-003.reason: Life Saalfeld does have a boulder area. The club's own documents (S LIFEBO Benutzungsordnung: rope-free climbing only "im Boulderraum" with soft-floor mats; S LIFEAGB: "Boulderbereich inklusive Trainingsbereich"; own page S LIFE: consent form "Selbstständiges Bouldern") confirm it, and the wall builder (S WALL) gives 165 m2 of bouldering. Open: own page S LIFE (hours Mon-Fri 8-22, Sat-Sun 10-19, climbing usable unsupervised during opening hours, 2026 courses and autumn-holiday climbing in Oct 2026). Same gym as first-pass dee-010 (deferred there for no boulder area on the web page; the PDFs settle it). Caveat: a fitness and health club with a climbing hall; price not on its own pages. Pin: OSM building way 198319533 carries the club's name and website but is tagged Albert-Schweitzer-Straße 51 while the club says Stauffenbergstraße 51; it is 677 m from the first pass's street-level pin, which was only the Stauffenbergstraße way, so the OSM building is the better pin. Worth a satellite look.

dh-004.reason: The St. Veit tower wall now has both things the first pass lacked: a boulder area (own page S DAVMR: "Boulderbereich 2,5 m", wall height 6 m, about 26 routes) and a street address (S DAVMA: Rainstraße 23, 98617 Sülzfeld; the OSM church building way 591242653 carries the same address, the 9 m match with dee-012 is the same gym). Open: S DAVM (in use since 2015, training groups and supervised adult free climbing Tue and Thu 19:30-21:30, price list with non-member tickets: adult 7 EUR for 2 h, youth 6 EUR; independent climbing needs a licence and a key; none on Sundays, holidays and during church events). Caveat: a DAV club wall in a church bell tower; the boulder area is small beside the rope walls. First-pass dee-012 stays deferred in its own section.

dh-005.reason: Not settled, see MANUAL-CHECK.md. The Zuckerturm's own pages (S ZT, S ZTH, S ZTG) show a DAV rope hall (660 m2, 24 toprope and 26 lead lines, about 70 routes) with no fixed opening hours (course times, other use by arrangement, members with key) and list no boulder area; the only boulder mentions are the DAV Boulderregeln text and a mobile boulder block for events. A directory summary claims a bouldering area, which the own pages do not support. Bouldering is therefore unknown, not confirmed absent.

dh-006.reason: DAV Sektion Saarbrücken's own hall page (S DAVSB) lists an 80 m2 Boulderfläche, a 200 m2 climbing area, training times Mon, Wed and Fri including adult "Klettertreff für Erwachsene / selbstständige Kletterer", and use by application form plus fee (the first pass deferred it because it only had the 27 Feb 2022 announcement). The same schedule is on the current hall page, and the section blog (S DAVSBN) shows the hall in use in 2025-2026: "Tag der offenen Tür 2026" at the hall on 7 Nov 2026 (post of 14 Sep 2026), new routes April 2025, youth assembly Dec 2025. Same gym as first-pass dee-026 (0 m), which stays deferred in its own section. Caveat: club hall with set sessions and a form and fee for outsiders, no walk-in day pass; the page itself is undated. The OSM building way 98872570 is the hall (its operator tag is outdated).
